_contract: program/one-system 06_pipelines. Limits for bot tools (Nick's Stack parts on OpenMausBot bots). StarNet enforces the permission gate: any mission needing send_email, send_sms, spend, publish or deploy parks for owner authorization. Each bot runtime must also enforce the per-bot limits below; a tool whose limits it cannot enforce stays off.

agentmail.send: only after the owner approves that message, or a named batch or template, recorded in Found First Approvals

limits.recipients: people who wrote first, opted in, or are on an owner-approved list
limits.cold_outreach_domain: separate approved sending domain, never the main agency domains

agentmail.client_engagements: no email automation for a client unless the client grants it in writing

agentcard.requires: card-level enforcement of these limits and a merchant allowlist per card; every charge logged on its Paperclip mission
agentcard.otherwise: owner approval in Found First first

agentphone.send: only to people who consented, from owner-approved templates, 08:00 to 21:00 in the recipient's time, STOP honored immediately
agentphone.prerequisite: US business texting registration (A2P 10DLC) complete; Mexico rules checked separately; no sending before
agentphone.client_texting: uses the client's own number and consent records, approved by the client
